summary:
w235 planned in plan.md: work delegate (requests#r65-r68, r70-r72).
scripts/work gets a delegate subcommand; workqueue_request.delegate goes through _change (commit, r66): refuses an empty delegation (r67) and delivered/refused/withdrawn requests naming the status (r68, not SETTLED); writes the JSON-quoted delegation field, adding it when absent (r65); no turn check; status and turn kept (r70, r71).
r72: the instruction is carried by a new UserPromptSubmit hook (a migrate subcommand, new scripts/migrate_prompt.py, hooks.json entry), not SessionStart, because migration-tools#r24 says that hook tells the session nothing when no initiative is open. The scenario runs the hook as the harness does, and a session double acts only on the hook's instruction.
Steps: the_upstream_runs reads the delegate form; new Givens/Thens in requests_write_steps.py; r72 steps in the new requests_session_steps.py, imported by test_requests.py.
No kept test broken (verified by search: the hook tests look up their hooks by key; take-in form unchanged).
